response.overview: This feature-length documentary offers an intimate, detailed look at the three-year production process behind the feature film "Mother Mary." It provides a fascinating glimpse behind the scenes—spanning various departments and filming Locations — from the costume department and dance rehearsals to sound mixing and the film’s premiere. Featured in the documentary are director David Lowery, along with stars Michaela Coel, Hunter Schafer, Kaia Gerber, and FKA twigs.
response.title: The Making of Mother Mary
